## Baseline decision comes first

Before editing any access code, capture the actual production gate-expander native release lowering at the approved base with `cargo rustc --locked --release -p gate-expander --lib -- --emit=asm,llvm-ir`, isolated target directory, normal x86-64-v3 configuration, exact toolchain/profile/source/command/status. Locate production Gate process/run_segment instantiations and the inline gate_block access region; unrelated Lane probes do not count. Record whether DualMono still executes partner access and whether equal cross-plane taps still execute duplicate access. A lack of a standalone gate_block symbol is expected under inline(always): inspect mapped callers/IR, not fabricated missing-symbol counts.

Reuse #475's baseline source-mapping/production-caller approach. If shipped LTO makes the region uninspectable, an explicitly supplemental LTO=false capture is allowed only identically for baseline and candidate; label its limits. #475's scalar/simd128 disassembly provenance preserves complete decoded function blocks and actual object identities; reuse its successful decoder procedure on existing Wasm corpus artifacts when qualifying the eventual candidate. Do not credit a bad-magic/failed decode, or source stores as executed loads. #499 was populated-state correctness repair and generated no new lowering; its useful lesson is priming beyond latency, not a second lowering tool.

Decision record before implementation: (a) both avoidable access cases survive in identifiable production lowering -> one issue may implement both; (b) only one survives -> freeze only that arm and record the other as an honest compiler-eliminated/null result; (c) neither survives -> no access rewrite justified for performance, retain the null and seek owner ruling on DYN2 closure/disposition; (d) lowering is inconclusive -> state exactly what mapping is missing and obtain a bounded ruling before implementation, not an assumed benefit. No projected speedup or timing claim follows from any of these outcomes.

## One closable access outcome, conditional on baseline

Both candidate cases share one access helper/classification and the same caller/ring invariants, so they fit one issue rather than two prerequisites: DualMono needs only each channel's own tap; linked modes with tapL[lane]==tapR[lane] for every active lane can reuse the opposite own vector. Equal cross-plane taps may be ragged across tracks. Linked unequal taps keep the original four gathers. Classify once per actual segment, not once per frame or in a persistent cache. Pass the immutable metadata link decision through private GateArgs/run_segment as needed; leave channel_step arithmetic unchanged. Do not add uniform-row copying, per-lane branch dispatch, shared multiband code or a general detector framework.

Preserve main versus connected detector source, write-before-read including zero tap, each channel's own offset for BOTH input planes, wrapping u32 subtraction/addition and power-of-two mask, dry delay, cursor, link Maximum/Average law and arithmetic order, ramp split, latency, rings and serialized state. Inactive width padding does not classify. Recompute after restore/reset/copy via existing segment entry, with no new serialized field. Corpus pins and tolerances stay immutable.

## Exact files and existing helpers

Production: `crates/gate-expander/src/kernel.rs` and the private caller in `crates/gate-expander/src/lib.rs` only. Tests: cfg(test) access oracle in kernel.rs plus bounded edits to existing `tests/identity.rs` and `tests/state.rs`; use existing `tests/support/mod.rs` helpers without introducing a new fixture library. Numbered spec/evidence belong to root. No Cargo/dependency/backend override changes.

Existing support provides initial_values/active_values/set_parameter, request/request_at/prepare, prepare_bank/prepare_bank_w8, render_scalar_sidechain, snapshot/snapshot_bank, assert_bits_eq, noise, packed_w8/track_of and retarget_spans. These already support actual populated PCM/full-state comparison. Connected sidechain is unbankable: cover it through the real scalar factory, not an invented connected bank. Native W4 can be unavailable by design; direct private Lane access oracle plus supported scalar/SIMD corpus evidence does not require reopening the public backend contract.

Specific reuse:
- identity::lane_identity_scalar_w8 covers all three link modes, long populated rings, automation and tail blocks. Its current lookahead array is palindromic, so reversed indexing STILL makes L/R taps equal; do not cite it as unequal-tap coverage. Extend its local fixture with exactly one non-palindromic cross-plane profile to retain a meaningful unequal linked fallback comparator.
- identity::partition_invariance and signed_zero_identity_is_bit_exact retain partition/D7 claims.
- state::active_restore_continues_against_uninterrupted and a_track_restores_into_a_bank_whose_cursor_is_elsewhere provide real snapshot/restore continuation; extend one bounded case only if needed to cross equal/unequal classification at the next populated render. Existing reset tests and nonfinite recovery stay unchanged. Prime past actual latency and prove nonzero/differing alternate-tap words before crediting transition PCM; #499 showed startup silence is not proof.
- contract::the_lookahead_tap_lands_the_detector_exactly_where_the_brief_says and active_sidechain_and_exact_automation_state_are_observable retain timing/connected-source behavior; bank_validation_precedes_fallback_and_unavailable_w4_is_legal retains dispatch boundaries.
- determinism::every_case_agrees_at_every_width_and_matches_its_pin / no_case_is_vacuous, existing scalar/W8 oracle tests and production-factory conformance remain unchanged acceptance foundations.

## Finite focused evidence and commands

One private old-access oracle at W1/W4/W8 uses distinct signed plane/row/lane words and compares the detector inputs actually consumed for DualMono, linked cross-plane equal (including lane-ragged), and linked unequal cases. Use zero-tap, physical-wrap and u32 cursor-wrap positions; W1 can still have unequal L/R taps. Freeze these access cases instead of adding a large DSP corpus. An actual-branch witness confirms reduced route execution; one deliberate dispatch-bypass mutation must fail that SAME positive mechanism assertion while the old-word oracle still agrees. No broader mutation campaign.

Run `cargo test --locked -p gate-expander --lib` and release equivalent for the new nonempty oracle; `cargo test --locked -p gate-expander --test identity` and `--test state` debug/release for changed fixtures. Run one full `cargo test --locked -p gate-expander` to retain contract/conformance/determinism/oracle; do not rerun every integration suite separately and again as a matrix. Use existing conformance allocation evidence and supported Wasm corpus replay, affected strict Clippy/all-targets, fmt and existing realtime/lane/workspace/environment policies. Record actual test names/counts; skipped native W4 is not a W4 execution claim. Candidate production lowering must show the chosen route/mechanism or report an honest no-improvement outcome; never tune until a desired instruction count appears.

No timed benchmark, second allocator, corpus repin, listening campaign, AArch64 qualification or performance percentage is authorized. Existing descriptive benchmarks can be a separately frozen weekly follow-up. Conditional on an informative baseline, this is one half-day access change with reused correctness evidence; if it needs a new backend/harness or effect algorithm change, stop and split before editing. DYN2 status can only credit the exact accepted source/lowering outcome and actual delivery; DYN3 remains OPEN.

Baseline/candidate capture is untimed and uses the same supported toolchain/profile/ISA with isolated output directories; raw command, source identity, toolchain, status and original artifact identities must be retained. Scope narrows to only demonstrated avoidable access; an inconclusive baseline is a stop for one bounded Astra ruling, not permission for a new probe framework or speculative implementation.

After baseline authorization, Luna makes one private production access change and the compact old-access/witness test tranche, compiles/runs the focused gate, then pauses for root’s exact-path checkpoint/push before adding the bounded public fixture/state evidence. All real failures remain evidence; no raw output may be reconstructed. Root synchronizes this spec/GitHub issue after material pushed checkpoints. One consolidated adversarial review follows the finished attempt; a failed attempt goes to Sol under the frozen limit rather than accumulating disguised retries.

Delivery requires source/evidence PASS, proportional ordinary artifact/affected consumer checks, actual PR-head/current-base PASS and required qualification SUCCESS. Root asserts live main and PR head immediately before exact-head merge, verifies the actual merge parents and closes/synchronizes the issue once accepted evidence is upstream. Report only the exact delivered source/lowering effect. This untimed access investigation is not a numerical optimization loop or a cycle-floor exit report; no arithmetic algorithm, floor, corpus identity or release budget is changed. Any later timing/algorithm proposal requires its own frozen scope and applicable floor accounting.
